notes:
- you can declare and redeclare `blobModule`s
- `blobModule`s don't share state across iframe boundary, but
  they do share state across modules in the same page.
- import code has to be defined inside the iframe otherwise `window`
  in the imported library will be `window.top` not the iframe's window.
  This would break importing web component modules because you can't use
  web componenets defined/registered in the host page inside of an iframe,
  you have to register them inside the iframe.
